feats.name: Fire Bolt (Sp) — 8/day
feats.shortDesc: Standard action: ranged touch attack within 30 ft. that deals 1d6+2 fire damage.
feats.fullDesc: As a standard action, Noorie unleashes a scorching bolt of divine fire. She can target any single foe within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack with this bolt of fire. If it hits, the fire bolt deals 1d6+2 points of fire damage. She can use this ability 8 times per day. This is a domain power from the Ash Subdomain.

feats.name: Wild Shape (1/day, 5 hours)
feats.shortDesc: Transform into a Small or Medium animal once per day for up to 5 hours.
feats.fullDesc: Noorie can change shape once per day for up to 5 hours, assuming the form of a Small or Medium animal (as per beast shape I). She gains the animal's natural attacks, movement types, and extraordinary abilities while in that form. Equipment melds into the form unless it is magical jewelry, which resizes.

feats.name: Natural Spell
feats.shortDesc: Cast spells normally (V, S, M, F) even while transformed via Wild Shape.
feats.fullDesc: You can complete the verbal and somatic components of spells while using wild shape, substituting natural noises and gestures for normal components. You can also use any material components or focuses you possess, even if melded into your form. Does not allow speaking normally or activating magic items unusable by your form.

feats.name: Combat Casting
feats.shortDesc: +4 on concentration checks when casting defensively or while grappled.
feats.fullDesc: You get a +4 bonus on concentration checks made to cast a spell or use a spell-like ability when casting on the defensive or while grappled. Noorie's base concentration total is +10 (WIS +5 + level 5), giving +14 when casting defensively.

feats.name: Improved Initiative
feats.shortDesc: +4 bonus on initiative checks (already included in initiative +7).
feats.fullDesc: Your quick reflexes allow you to react quickly to danger. You get a +4 bonus on initiative checks. Combined with Noorie's DEX +3, her initiative is +7, meaning she very often acts first in combat.

feats.name: Endure Pain
feats.shortDesc: Attempt a Fortitude save (DC 10 + nonlethal damage dealt) to halve incoming nonlethal damage.
feats.fullDesc: Through violent and torturous conditioning, you have built up a resistance to pain. If you take nonlethal damage, you may attempt a Fortitude saving throw (DC equal to 10 + the nonlethal damage dealt) to reduce that damage by half. The Endurance feat grants a +4 bonus on this saving throw.

feats.name: Flame-Tested Survivor
feats.shortDesc: Hardened by the hottest flames; fire holds little fear for you.
feats.fullDesc: You have burned in the hottest flames, and your flesh bears the proof — fire holds little fear for you anymore.

feats.name: Resist Nature's Lure
feats.shortDesc: +4 bonus on saves vs. fey spell-like/supernatural abilities, and vs. spells targeting plants.
feats.fullDesc: Noorie gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against the spell-like and supernatural abilities of fey. This bonus also applies to spells and effects that utilize and target plants, such as Blight, Entangle, Spike Growth, and Warp Wood.

feats.name: Nature Magic
feats.shortDesc: Know Direction as a constant at-will SLA. May choose one additional druid orison usable 1/day as SLA.
feats.fullDesc: You gain Know Direction as a constant spell-like ability (always know which way is north). You can choose another druid orison to cast as a spell-like ability once per day. Your caster level for both of these spell-like abilities equals your character level (CL 5).

feats.name: Ash Subdomain (Fire Domain)
feats.shortDesc: Fire Resistance 5 (passive). Domain spells: Burning Hands (1st), Produce Flame (2nd), Fireball (3rd).
feats.fullDesc: Noorie worships Asmodeus and her Nature Bond is to the Fire domain (Ash subdomain). She gains Fire Resistance 5 permanently. Her domain spells are automatically added to her prepared list each level: Burning Hands (1st), Produce Flame (2nd), Fireball (3rd). The Fire Bolt ability is her domain power.

classAbilities.name: Spontaneous Casting (Summon Nature's Ally)
classAbilities.description: Noorie can sacrifice any prepared spell to spontaneously cast a Summon Nature's Ally spell of equal or lower level — no preparation needed. As NE, she applies the Fiendish template to all summoned creatures (DR 2/magic, resist 5 cold/fire/elec., Smite Good 1/day, Darkvision 60 ft.). She cannot summon Celestial-template creatures. See SNA I/II/III spells for full creature lists.

classAbilities.name: Nature Sense
classAbilities.description: +2 bonus on Knowledge (Nature) and Survival skill checks. Already included in skill totals.

classAbilities.name: Wild Empathy (+5)
classAbilities.description: Improve the attitude of an animal within 30 ft. (functions like Diplomacy: roll 1d20+5; takes 1 minute). Works on magical beasts with INT 1–2 at a −4 penalty.

classAbilities.name: Trackless Step / Woodland Stride
classAbilities.description: Noorie leaves no trail in natural surroundings (cannot be tracked) and can move through natural undergrowth at full speed without damage or impairment.

classAbilities.name: Wisdom in the Flesh (Stealth)
classAbilities.description: Noorie makes Stealth checks using her Wisdom modifier (+5) instead of Dexterity (+3). Stealth is treated as a class skill for her. This is why her Stealth total is 10 (WIS 5 + ranks 2 + class skill 3).

spells.name: Know Direction (At Will)
spells.description: Innate SLA from Nature Magic (constant / at will). You instantly know the direction of north from your current position.

spells.name: Create Water
spells.description: Generates up to 10 gallons of wholesome, drinkable water (2 gallons/CL).

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: You detect magical auras within a 60-foot cone.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.description: Imbues the subject with a +1 competence bonus on one attack roll, saving throw, or skill check of their choice.

spells.name: Light
spells.description: Causes a touched object to glow like a torch.

spells.name: Stabilize
spells.description: Stabilizes a living creature at negative HP so it stops dying.

spells.name: Virtue
spells.description: Grants the subject 1 temporary hit point for 1 minute.

spells.name: Cure Light Wounds
spells.description: Channel positive energy to cure 1d8+5 hit points of damage on a living creature (CL 5).

spells.name: Burning Hands (Domain)
spells.description: A cone of searing flame deals 5d4 fire damage to all creatures in the area (CL 5). Domain spell — always prepared in the bonus domain slot.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.description: Plants in a 40-ft.-radius spread wrap around foes. Creatures that fail their Reflex save are entangled (−2 attack, −4 DEX) and must make a Strength/Escape Artist check to move. On success, speed is halved.

spells.name: Produce Flame
spells.description: Flames appear in your open hand. As a melee touch attack or ranged touch attack (30 ft. range increment), deal 1d6+5 fire damage (CL 5). One attack per round.

spells.name: Summon Nature's Ally I

summonOptions.name: Fiendish Riding Dog
summonOptions.specialAbilities: Trip (free on bite), DR 2/magic, Resist 5 cold/fire/elec., Smite Good 1/day (+4 dmg)

summonOptions.name: Fiendish Viper (Small)
summonOptions.specialAbilities: Poison (Fort DC 11, 1d2 Con/rd × 6 rd), DR 2/magic, Resist 5 cold/fire/elec.

summonOptions.name: Fiendish Eagle
summonOptions.specialAbilities: Fly 80 ft., Low-light vision, DR 2/magic, Resist 5 cold/fire/elec., Smite Good 1/day

spells.description:
Summons one creature for 5 rounds (CL 5). Noorie is NE — she can apply the Fiendish template to any creature (DR 2/magic, resist 5 cold/fire/electricity, Smite Good 1/day, Darkvision 60 ft.). Can also be cast spontaneously by sacrificing any prepared level-1 spell.

CREATURE OPTIONS:
• Fiendish Riding Dog (Medium) — AC 13, HP 13, Bite +3 (1d6+3, trip free). Best all-rounder: trip + flanking body.
• Fiendish Viper, Small (Small) — AC 16, HP 4, Bite +4 (1d2−2 + poison: 1d2 Con/rd × 6, Fort DC 11). Fragile but poisons reliably.
• Fiendish Eagle (Small) — AC 14, HP 6, Talons +3 (1d4+1), Fly 80 ft. Aerial flanker, low-light vision.
• Fiendish Dire Rat (Small) — AC 13, HP 5, Bite +1 (1d4 + filth fever disease Fort DC 11).
• Fiendish Pony (Medium) — AC 13, HP 13, 2 Hooves +2 (1d3+1). Cheap flanking body.

spells.name: Speak with Animals
spells.description: You can ask questions of and receive answers from animals. The spell doesn't make them more friendly. Unusual or fantastical concepts are beyond their grasp.

spells.name: Barkskin
spells.description: Toughens a creature's skin, granting a +2 enhancement bonus to the creature's existing natural armor bonus for 50 minutes (CL 5). Toggle the 'Barkskin' buff above to track the AC change.

spells.name: Produce Flame (Domain Lvl 2)
spells.description: Domain slot version of Produce Flame — always prepared in the Ash Subdomain bonus level-2 slot. Deals 1d6+5 fire damage (CL 5) as melee or ranged touch attack.

spells.name: Flaming Sphere
spells.description: A 5-ft.-diameter burning globe rolls in the direction you point and burns those it strikes for 3d6 fire damage (Reflex DC 17 negates). Move it 30 ft. per round as a move action.

spells.name: Summon Nature's Ally II

summonOptions.name: Fiendish Crocodile

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.notes: Grab on hit → free grapple (Death Roll: 1d8+6 + 1d4+4)

summonOptions.specialAbilities: Grab (free grapple on bite), Death Roll while grappling, DR 2/magic, Resist 5 cold/fire/elec.

summonOptions.name: Fiendish Wolf
summonOptions.specialAbilities: Trip (free on bite), DR 2/magic, Resist 5 cold/fire/elec., Smite Good 1/day

summonOptions.name: Fiendish Hyena
summonOptions.specialAbilities: Trip (free on bite), DR 2/magic, Resist 5 cold/fire/elec., Smite Good 1/day

summonOptions.name: Fiendish Giant Eagle
summonOptions.specialAbilities: Fly 80 ft., Evasion, DR 2/magic, Resist 5 cold/fire/elec., Smite Good 1/day

summonOptions.name: Fiendish Giant Ant (Worker)
summonOptions.specialAbilities: Poison (Fort DC 14, 1d2 Str), Acid resist 10, Scent, DR 2/magic, Resist 5 cold/fire/elec.

spells.description:
Summons one SNA II creature OR 1d3 SNA I creatures of the same kind for 5 rounds (CL 5). Fiendish template applies to all (DR 2/magic, resist 5 cold/fire/electricity, Smite Good 1/day). Can also be cast spontaneously by sacrificing any prepared level-2 spell.

SNA II CREATURE OPTIONS (one creature):
• Fiendish Crocodile (Medium) — AC 14, HP 22, Bite +6 (1d8+4, grab → death roll 1d8+6). BEST PICK: devastating grappler.
• Fiendish Wolf (Medium) — AC 14, HP 13, Bite +3 (1d6+2, trip). Flanking + trip.
• Fiendish Hyena (Medium) — AC 14, HP 13, Bite +3 (1d6+3, trip). Slightly stronger bite than wolf.
• Fiendish Giant Eagle (Large) — AC 15, HP 26, 2 Talons +5 (1d6+3) + Bite, Fly 80 ft. Aerial powerhouse.
• Fiendish Giant Ant, Worker (Medium) — AC 17, HP 13, Bite +3 (1d6+3 + poison: 1d2 Str Fort DC 14). High AC option.

spells.name: Resist Energy
spells.description: Grants a creature limited protection from damage of one chosen energy type (acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic). Protects against 10 points of that damage per attack for 50 minutes.

spells.name: Fireball (Domain Lvl 3)
spells.description: Ash Subdomain bonus level-3 spell — always prepared in the domain slot. Generates a searing 20-ft.-radius explosion of flame dealing 5d6 points of fire damage to every creature within the area (CL 5).

spells.name: Call Lightning
spells.description: Immediately upon completion and once per round thereafter as a standard action (up to 5 bolts total), call down a 5-ft.-wide, 30-ft.-long vertical bolt of lightning dealing 3d6 electricity damage (3d10 outdoors in stormy weather).

spells.name: Cure Moderate Wounds
spells.description: When laying your hand upon a living creature, you channel positive energy that cures 2d8+5 points of damage (CL 5).

spells.name: Summon Nature's Ally III

summonOptions.name: Fiendish Dire Wolf
summonOptions.specialAbilities: Trip (free on bite), Scent, DR 5/magic (5 HD), Resist 10 cold/fire, Smite Good 1/day (+5 dmg)

summonOptions.name: Fiendish Lion
summonOptions.specialAbilities: Pounce (full attack on charge + 2 rakes), Grab, Scent, DR 5/magic (5 HD), Resist 10 cold/fire, Smite Good 1/day

summonOptions.name: Fiendish Leopard
summonOptions.specialAbilities: Pounce, Grab, Rake, Climb 20 ft., Scent, Resist 5 cold/fire, Smite Good 1/day

summonOptions.name: Fiendish Constrictor Snake
summonOptions.specialAbilities: Grab, Constrict (1d4+4), Climb/Swim 20 ft., Scent, Resist 5 cold/fire

summonOptions.name: Fiendish Aurochs
summonOptions.specialAbilities: Trample (2d6+9), Stampede, Scent, Resist 5 cold/fire, Smite Good 1/day

spells.description:
Summons one 3rd-level natural creature, 1d3 2nd-level creatures, or 1d4+1 1st-level creatures of the same kind for 5 rounds (CL 5). Can be cast spontaneously by sacrificing any prepared 3rd-level spell. Fiendish template applies to all summons.

SNA III HIGHLIGHTS:
• Fiendish Lion (Large) — AC 15, HP 32, Pounce (Bite +7 1d8+5, 2 Claws +7 1d4+5, 2 Rakes 1d4+5), Grab. Top burst damage.
• Fiendish Dire Wolf (Large) — AC 14, HP 37, Bite +7 (1d8+6, free Trip +8). Best frontline controller.
• 1d3 Fiendish Crocodiles (SNA II) or 1d4+1 Fiendish Riding Dogs (SNA I) for horde control.

spells.name: Ash Storm
spells.description: Driving ash fills a 40-ft.-radius, 20-ft.-high cylinder, blocking all sight (including darkvision), making the ground difficult terrain (Acrobatics DC 10 or fall prone), and imposing −4 Perception and concentration checks.

spells.name: Protection from Energy
spells.description: Grants temporary immunity to one chosen energy type (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic), absorbing up to 60 points of damage (12/CL) before discharging.

spells.name: Resinous Skin
spells.description: Coats you in a flexible layer of sticky resin: gain DR 5/piercing, +4 bonus to CMD against disarm, +2 bonus on grapple checks, and weapons striking you may stick (Reflex DC 18 negates).

spells.name: Neutralize Poison
spells.description: Detoxifies any sort of venom in the creature or object touched (caster level check against poison DC).

spells.name: Remove Disease
spells.description: Cures all diseases from which the subject is suffering (caster level check against disease DC).

spells.name: Sleet Storm
spells.description: Driving sleet fills a 40-ft.-radius, 20-ft.-high cylinder, blocking all sight (including darkvision) and coating the ground in ice (half speed with Acrobatics DC 10).

spells.name: Aqueous Orb
spells.description: Creates a 10-ft.-diameter rolling sphere of churning water that moves up to 30 ft./round (move action), dealing 2d6 nonlethal damage and engulfing Large or smaller creatures (Reflex DC 18 negates).

spells.name: Stone Shape
spells.description: Forms an existing piece of stone (up to 15 cu. ft. at CL 5) into any shape that suits your purpose.

inventory.name: Leather Armor
inventory.description: +2 AC, light armor, Max DEX +6, ACP 0, 10% ASF.

inventory.name: Sling
inventory.description: Ranged weapon (1d4+1, 50 ft. range increment) using sling bullets.

inventory.name: Bullets, Sling
inventory.description: Smooth sling bullets carried in belt pouch.

inventory.name: Pouch, Belt
inventory.description: Belt pouch holding sling bullets and small druid focuses.

inventory.name: Backpack, Common
inventory.description: Adventuring backpack holding travel supplies and waterskin.

inventory.name: Waterskin, Filled
inventory.description: Holds half a gallon of water.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.notes: Trip maneuver (+5 CMB) on successful hit

specialQualities.name: Trip (Ex)
specialQualities.description: A wolf that hits with its bite attack can attempt to trip the opponent as a free action without provoking attacks of opportunity.

specialQualities.name: Scent (Ex)
specialQualities.description: Can detect approaching enemies, sniff out hidden foes, and track by sense of smell within 30 ft.

specialQualities.name: Evasion (Ex)
specialQualities.description: If subjected to an attack that allows a Reflex save for half damage, takes no damage on a successful save.

specialQualities.name: Link (Ex)
specialQualities.description: Noorie can handle Ignis with a free action, or push with a move action, gaining a +4 circumstance bonus on Handle Animal checks.

specialQualities.name: Share Spells (Ex)
specialQualities.description: Noorie may cast a spell with a target of 'You' on Ignis instead of herself.

masterLink.notes: Free action to handle, +4 circumstance bonus.
